tasks.label: Test PostgreSQL Raw Socket
tasks.command: $socket = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient('100.99.85.73', 15432); $stream = $socket.GetStream(); $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream); $writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($stream); $writer.AutoFlush = $true; $writer.WriteLine("SELECT 1;"); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; while ($stream.DataAvailable) { Write-Host ($reader.ReadLine()) }; $socket.Close(); Write-Host 'Socket test done.'
